technology_name: PREPARATION OF A GRAPHITIC CARBON NITRIDE AND HEMATITE COMPOSITE (g-C3N4-a-Fe2O3) COATED MELAMINE FOAM FOR TREATING OILY WASTEWATER
institution: National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut)
problem_solved: Standard absorbent pads lack robust mechanical durability, cannot separate oil-water emulsions effectively, and are difficult to squeeze out and reuse cleanly in high-volume marine spills.
description: A highly resilient composite oil-sorbent foam manufactured by chemically coating a base melamine sponge skeleton with a superhydrophobic, superoleophilic graphitic carbon nitride and hematite (g-C3N4-a-Fe2O3) nanoparticle blend.
applications: Marine oil spill emergency response kits, petroleum refinery separation basins, industrial machine wash water filtration, and bilge water purification lines.
